beschreibung:
Todd and Julie are back, and this week’s conversation goes everywhere from being total opposites when it comes to leaving the house, to the shows they can’t stop watching and the very questionable things Todd believes he sees on Instagram.
They also get real about health, aging, and why Todd has finally stopped obsessing over the number on the scale. After sharing his recent bloodwork and how much better he feels, the two talk about the importance of actually understanding your body, taking care of yourself, and not letting shame keep you from asking for help.
Then, Todd and Julie read some of the messages they’ve received from listeners, including one from someone who changed their perspective after doing their own research about the Chrisleys’ case and pardon. They also talk about the impact of their prison advocacy, some hilarious viral moments from the podcast, and the social media accounts they’ve become oddly invested in.
